comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Operates online and campus degree universities for adult learners, military and working professionals, funded by Title IV and tuition assistance, like Strayer and Capella.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Outsources services to partner universities for a revenue share, rather than operating universities and collecting tuition directly.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Small California campus-based allied health vocational colleges, not online adult degree programs or employer-sponsored education.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Operates for-profit online universities for adult students on tuition funded by Title IV, closely matching Strayer and Capella.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Mainly K-12 virtual schools funded by public school per-pupil payments, a different customer and business than adult higher education.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Campus-based hands-on trade and technician training for young students, different from online degrees for working adults.
